{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue as float (remove commas)
completed_data['revenue_numeric'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute average revenue per order for each channel in the completed population
avg_revenue_email = completed_data[completed_data['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_numeric'].mean()
avg_revenue_paid_search = completed_data[completed_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the required values
print(f"Average revenue (email): {avg_revenue_email:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue (paid_search): {avg_revenue_paid_search:.2f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_paid_search:.2f}")"}
